text:
Maya (HW Partnerships): Quick sync 9: Sable sent 2 x 4U eval boards for the marketplace validation. We need a concise bench plan (perf/W, sustained throughput, thermal curve) and a short SI-facing integration note. Who can run it and own artifacts?

Diego (Bench Eng): I can lead the lab runs. Thinking: three pillars  tokens-per-joule normalized to 1k tokens, sustained throughput at target latency, and thermal headroom profile (fan curves + throttling thresholds). Will script everything so partner can reproduce.

Priya (Product): For marketplace we must publish: container digest, AMI hash, driver/kernel versions, and a 1-paragraph compatibility note. Also want an "assumptions" box for the slide deck.

Jules (Platform): Ill provision a tainted nodepool (sable:true) and attach PDU-level power meters. Which meter model? Need driver & sampling rate.

bench-bot: created /runs/sable-3300123456/manifest.yaml

Diego (Bench Eng): Test matrix (concise):
- models: redwood-compat-13b, redwood-compat-70b
- batches: 1, 4, 16
- seq len: 256, 512, 1024
- kernel modes: stock, sparse-kernel, tiled-alloc
- quant modes: fp16, q4_0, int8-ptq
- steady window: 600s (discard first 60s warmup)
- power sample rate: 2s (PDU + on-board VRM if available)
- tags: partner=sable, hw=4u-s1, env=marketplace-staging

Maya (HW Partnerships): Partner asks for tokens-per-joule normalized to 1k tokens and a delta column vs their in-house baseline. They also want per-accelerator breakdown if we can attach VRM probes.

Diego (Bench Eng): Well compute tokens_per_joule = tokens_generated / (energy_joules) and output CSV with delta_vs_partner and per-component wattage. Example run: 

```\
./bench_harness \
  --model redwood-compat-70b \
  --batch 16 \
  --seq 1024 \
  --quant q4_0 \
  --kernel tiled-alloc \
  --power-source /dev/pdu0 \
  --sample-interval 2 \
  --steady 600 \
  --out /runs/sable-3300123456/70b-q4_tiled.json
```

Priya (Product): Messaging note: do not claim absolute gains. Use wording like "validated efficiency characteristics on Sable 4U under specified test conditions." We'll include a small appendix listing exact kernel patches.

Jules (Platform): I'll tag nodes `sable=true board=4u-s1` and mount a dedicated s3 bucket for telemetry. Please ensure run outputs write to /runs/sable-3300123456/ so we collect artifacts centrally.

Diego (Bench Eng): Adding fallback behavior test: if quantized kernel fails, fall back to fp16 path and emit bench metric `bench.fallback_reason`. Snippet for runbook logs: 

```\n[bench] load tiled-alloc
[bench] quantize -> q4_0 ok
[bench] runtime error: tiled-alloc OOM on alloc_gpu
[bench] fallback -> fp16-stock
[metrics] bench.fallback_reason=OOM
```

Maya (HW Partnerships): Good. Partner also requested a short SI note explaining behavior when tiled kernels aren't available and how to opt into safe-fallback for enterprise customers. Can we include a short script they can drop into their deployment?

Diego (Bench Eng): Will add a small wrapper script and a kubernetes example (deployment.yaml snippet) showing preferred kernelRef and fallbackPolicy.

bench-bot: power-meter detected: OnyxPWR-v2 at /dev/pdu0; firmware=1.4.2

Jules (Platform): OnyxPWR-v2 sampling looks solid. I'll ensure the driver is on the image and post checksums here when images are staged. ETA Tue EOD.

Priya (Product): Timeline proposal:
- Tue: runbook and matrix final review
- Thu-Fri: lab runs (partner remote watch)
- Mon: aggregate results + internal review
- Wed: draft slide + SI note sent to partner for review

Maya (HW Partnerships): That timeline works for Sable. Please flag any blockers by Monday noon. Also confirm partner SLA expectations for the marketplace listing so we can demo a Console route.

Diego (Bench Eng): One ask: define the p95 latency SLO for each test profile so we can label runs e.g., p95_target=120ms@seq512. Otherwise throughput-only runs skew energy numbers.

Maya (HW Partnerships): Partner expects p95 < 120ms at seq=512 for the marketplace image and 99.95% availability. We'll include that.

Jules (Platform): Noted. I'll wire up a synthetic alert that simulates 99.95% availability on the sample route.

Priya (Product): I'll draft the 1-pager for partner comms and a short SI checklist (driver, kernel, fallback). Putting a placeholder PR: https://git.redwood.ai/docs/pulls/475

Diego (Bench Eng): scheduling window requested: 2026-04-02T08:00Z - 2026-04-03T20:00Z. bench-bot?

bench-bot: run-window reserved: 2026-04-02T08:00Z to 2026-04-03T20:00Z; rack=sable-4u-s1; bucket=s3://redwood-telemetry/sable-3300123456

Maya (HW Partnerships): Thanks team. Please drop final signoffs here by Monday 16:00 PT. I'll bundle runbook + NDA excerpt + comms timeline and share with Sable. If something blocks, ping me directly. :handshake:
